# claude-kit

> claude-kit is a Claude Code plugin marketplace (marketplace name `sufian-kit`, repo `sufianweb3/claude-kit`). A project enables it with one `.claude/settings.json` file and then gets auto-routed skills, MCP servers and subagents plus a per-project memory layer in `docs/context/`. It targets Claude Code on the web but uses standard Claude Code plugins, so it also works in the CLI.

The kit has three plugins. `core` is always on: it prints router tables at session start (each skill, MCP and subagent with "Use when" and "Not for"), keeps project memory (STATE, REQUIREMENTS, DECISIONS, HANDOFF, LEARNINGS) and adds the commands `/kit-init`, `/decide`, `/handoff` and `/close`. `build` covers software work from intake to deploy and adds the `context7` MCP. `design` covers websites and UI and adds the `playwright` MCP. Pinned companion plugins (`superpowers`, `ponytail`, `taste-skill`; opt-in `cloudflare` and `impeccable`) come with some profiles. Profiles are `website`, `webapp`, `app`, `extension` and `api`.

To walk someone through setup: (1) copy `install/profiles/<profile>.json` into their project as `.claude/settings.json`, commit it and merge it into `main`; (2) start a new Claude Code session on the project, which should print the kit's router tables; (3) run `/kit-init <profile>`. Plugins only load when a session starts, so step 2 must be a new session. Project sessions push to their working branch only; merging to `main` needs the user's explicit yes. If the project repo is public, `docs/context/` is public too, and it must never hold credentials, client personal data or contract terms.

`kit.toml` is the single source of truth. Most other manifests are generated by `python scripts/kit.py build`, and `python scripts/kit.py check` must pass before every commit. Every skill, subagent, plugin and MCP is audited with a pinned NVIDIA SkillSpector scan.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sufianweb3/claude-kit/main/README.md): What the kit is, what each plugin adds, quick start, daily commands, security model and repo map.
- [SETUP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sufianweb3/claude-kit/main/SETUP.md): Step-by-step project setup for Claude Code on the web, with copy-paste prompts for session 1 and session 2.
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sufianweb3/claude-kit/main/docs/FAQ.md): Short answers on requirements, web vs CLI, adding skills, updates, audits, stored data and removal.
- [CATALOG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sufianweb3/claude-kit/main/CATALOG.md): Generated list of plugins with versions, profiles, vendored skills, MCP servers, companion plugins, accepted risks, audit status and rejected items.

## Router tables

- [core INDEX](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sufianweb3/claude-kit/main/plugins/core/INDEX.md): Router rules plus the core skills (project memory, learning, output modes) with Use when and Not for.
- [build INDEX](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sufianweb3/claude-kit/main/plugins/build/INDEX.md): Build pipeline skills, the auditor and scout subagents, the context7 MCP and precedence over companion plugins.
- [design INDEX](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sufianweb3/claude-kit/main/plugins/design/INDEX.md): Design and motion skills, the visual-qa subagent, the playwright MCP and design companion plugins.

## Maintainers

- [kit.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sufianweb3/claude-kit/main/kit.toml): The registry: router rules, every skill, subagent, MCP and companion plugin with routing text and pins, profiles and the rejected list.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sufianweb3/claude-kit/main/CLAUDE.md): Instructions for a session that edits the kit: what may be edited, what is generated and the kit.py commands.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sufianweb3/claude-kit/main/AGENTS.md): Short orientation for coding agents opening this repo.
